description: Defines a mutex interface for the Starboard platform, including mutex creation, destruction, acquisition, try-acquisition, and release functions, along with related types and constants.

methods.name: SbMutexCreate
methods.description: Creates a new mutex and returns success status.

methods.name: SbMutexAcquire
methods.description: Blocks until the mutex is acquired.

methods.name: SbMutexAcquireTry
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the mutex without blocking.

methods.name: SbMutexRelease
methods.description: Releases the mutex held by the current thread.
